profile.headline: Half Geek-Half Human Software Developer at Atiba
profile.summary: Systems Architect/Software Engineer with almost thirty years of experience designing and writing applications. Knowledgeable of a wide variety of languages and technologies including C#, Python, and Ruby. Specializes in back-end systems.

positions.title: Owner, Chief Software Architect
positions.description: Providing custom software development to clients in various industries, from healthcare to agriculture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
E-COMMERCE PLATFORM
Integrated the open-source nopCommerce platform with our internal systems with only one minor change to the nopCommerce codebase, making upgrades to new versions of that product almost trivial.

* Leveraged Azure service busses and akka.Net actors to communicate between multiple nopCommerce websites running on Azure and our product and order systems in near-real time.
* Exposed system metrics in real-time to administrators with an integrated NancyFx website.

COMMUNICATION HUB 
Designed and created a centralized communication hub capable of communicating with users on behalf of multiple applications using a variety of different communication channels.

* Initially provided email and HipChat channels, but the system is extensible to include other communication media. Each channel added is instantly available to all client applications, which remain agnostic to the actual means of communication used to deliver the message.

IMAGE SERVER 
The Perseus Image Server provided consistent and immediate access to our client's title covers, back covers, internal artwork, and other marketing images at any size desired.

HELIX WEB SITE 
Maintained and modernized the legacy Helix title metadata management and reporting system.

positions.title: Owner, Chief Engineer
positions.description: Lighthouse Recording is a small recording studio based in Lexington, TN. Although we specialize in Southern Gospel music, we record other genres as well. All-digital recording at extremely reasonable prices, and service that you won't find anywhere else!

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Perseus Books Group was purchased by Ingram Content Group in 2016. Descriptions of my work for Perseus are included under that company.

positions.title: Consultant at FedEx
positions.description:
Designed and maintained reports written using SQL Server Reporting Services client-side reports.

* Designed and implemented a XAML application to manage the XML-based report configuration files. Enables the developer to more easily understand, create, and edit the data contained in the arcane XML structures.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Led the complete redesign of client's 10-year-old medical records application from Access to a .NET Based WinForms|SQL Server platform using a modified Model-View-Controller architecture. 

* Reduced the time to add new measurement points by 75%. 
* Reduced the time required to generate reports by at least two orders of magnitude, and memory usage by several orders of magnitude. 
* Designed and implemented the application's HL7 messaging interface.
* Modeled the HL7 message structure as a .NET class.
* Created a custom domain-specific language (DSL) to determine how to route the HL7 message.

positions.title: Consultant -- AIM Healthcare
positions.description:
Reverse engineered and redesigned the client's ASP.Net-based reporting module decreasing response time by 30%. 

* Designed and implemented an extranet site that increased the capacity and capability of the existing system by more than 50%. 
* Designed and coded a web control to securely view and manipulate claim-related images.
* Enhanced the existing digital dashboard and document management system and finished 30% ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Consultant -- Carrier
positions.description: Assisted with the development of an ASP.NET application (SPOT) that tracks parts shipped from the customer's warehouse to the factory using Visual Basic for Applications, Visual Basic.NET, SQL Server 2000, and Intermec's RF-Gen Application Development Suite.

positions.title: Consultant at Newton, Oldacre, and McDonald
Content Developer
positions.description: Wrote practice exam content for Trancender's first .NET-based exams for Microsoft MCSD track.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer
positions.description:
Added new features to Transcender's exam engine.

Conceived and prototyped a new modular exam system including a content-creation editor and a new streamlined exam engine.

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Led the middle-tier development team during the Prometheus project, Ingram's Y2K remediation project.

* Successfully replaced the company's entire revenue system software in less than a year.
* Conceived, designed, and led the development of a web-based reporting system to distribute data from the Prometheus system to Ingram locations across the country.
